No 四季報/IFIS consensus found (kabuyoho consensus column empty: https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=3199), so the bar is the company plan only and every size is capped small. print_vs_bar is on operating profit; H1 sales likely MISS the 69,333m plan by ~3-4%.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register (baseline, as of 2026-10-28): 3.45% of shares outstanding across 3 disclosed sellers, up 0.51pt from 2.94% -- sellers building into the print. 信用倍率 2.60 (kabutan, 10/23: 売り残 10.8k / 買い残 28.1k shares, https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=3199); margin shorts collapsed from 111.9k on 09/25 to 12.8k on 10/02, the signature of 株主優待 cross trades unwinding after the September record date. No skew (no options). priced_lean_pct +1.235. 20d run-up -7.84%, 5d -5.12%: the stock has slid steadily from ~1,304 (09-25) to 1,187 into the print, at PER 9.7 / PBR 0.91.

findings.finding: H1 operating profit is likely to beat the H1 plan of 1,196m: Q1 delivered 631m (52.8% of the H1 plan vs 38.8% of the prior year's H1 plan at the same point), so Q2 needs only ~565m against 766m in Q2 last year, and construction (Q2 last year 448m segment profit, Q1 this year 361m vs 86m, 'ordering environment good') carries more than the retail drag; my build is Q2 ~600-750m, H1 ~1,230-1,380m, i.e. +3% to +15% over plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 vs plan has decided the last H1 prints: FY24 H1 (2023-10-31) beat its plan (1,032m vs 895m) and rose +1.81%; FY26 H1 (2025-10-27) missed its plan (1,449m vs 1,762m) with no pre-revision and fell -3.28%; FY25 H1 was pre-revised 2024-10-25 (+1.02%) and the print itself fell -1.42%. Q1 this year (2026-07-28, 56.8% ordinary-profit progress to H1) rose +2.25%. Closes from Yahoo chart in the baseline tape source.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q1 progress rate is public and was bought once (+2.25%), but the stock has since fallen ~11% from 1,335 to 1,187 with disclosed shorts adding 0.51pt in the last register; if a clean H1 beat were held, the stock would not be sliding into the print at 9.7x earnings. No analyst publishes an H1 number for this name, so the size of the beat is not on any screen. A beat under 30% does not trigger a mandatory pre-revision, so the absence of a 修正 says nothing against it.
findings.independence: Last year's H1 segment table (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251027/140120251027579057.pdf, 2025-10-27) gives the Q2 base by segment (retail 348m, construction 448m, trade 197m); the Q1 2026 短信 gives this year's run-rate. Both are company documents; the inference that construction carries Q2 is mine.

findings.finding: Retail 月次 for Q2 were weak again: all-store sales July 96.9%, August 96.1%, September 99.1% of last year (H1 cumulative 96.7%, customers 94.9%), so retail segment profit (348m in Q2 last year) is likely down again and consolidated H1 sales likely miss the 69,333m plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Retail weakness was visible in Q1 月次 (Apr 93.1, May 102.4, Jun 92.7) and the Q1 print still rose +2.25% on 2026-07-29 because consolidated profit tracked plan.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the series was public on 2026-10-09 and the H1 plan's -17.5% OP already embeds a weak retail half. What is left is only the retail margin, which the 月次 do not show.
findings.independence: Q1 短信 retail segment commentary (same company, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260728/140120260728500895.pdf) describes the same 節約志向 and seasonal weakness.

findings.finding: The full-year plan (OP 3,800m) implies H2 OP of ~2,604m against 2,150m in H2 last year (+21%) with retail still shrinking; the company held a plan it then missed last year (FY26 plan 3,840m vs actual 3,599m, H1 plan 1,762m vs 1,449m with no revision), so a held FY guide carries little credibility and a cut is possible but not this company's habit at H1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY26 H1 (2025-10-27): FY plan held despite an 18% H1 miss, stock -3.28%. No mid-year FY revision visible on kabutan's 修正履歴 for FY26 or FY27; FY25 had revisions on 2024-10-25 (+1.02%) and 2025-01-30.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced in the slide and the 9.7x PER; what is not priced is whether the release trims the FY number. The company's own pattern says it will not, which leaves this small.
findings.independence: kabutan 修正履歴 table, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=3199 (FY plan vs actual by year).

findings.finding: Watahan acquired 100% of 東陽興業 (electrical/instrumentation contractor, Iida) on 2026-09-24, so the H1 release may carry a consolidation note or a small FY forecast update for the construction segment from H2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior reaction on this line; the 2026-09-24 announcement itself moved the stock -0.23% (1,310 to 1,307).
findings.why_not_priced: The release gave no price, size or earnings effect, so nothing could be priced; the H1 短信 is the first document that has to state the consolidation scope. Likely immaterial.

outside_window.finding: Retail peak season (Q3 Oct-Dec, the largest quarter: OP 1,442m last year) decides whether the FY plan is reachable; October 月次 publishes around 2026-11-10.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive, which agrees with priced_lean_pct (+1.2, driven by the short-squeeze term) but cuts against the -7.8% 20-day slide and disclosed shorts building +0.51pt; the strongest positive the release could carry is a clean H1 OP beat with the FY plan held, which I looked for and think likely, while no buyback or dividend change is expected.
